_howToEdit: This file is everything Hannah knows. She answers ONLY from it and never makes facts up.
To teach her something new, copy one entry in 'topics', give it a new id, and change its keywords, phrases and answer.
keywords: single words a visitor might use (lower case). phrases: short word groups that strongly signal the topic.
answer: what Hannah says. Keep it to two or three short, friendly sentences.
followUp (optional): a yes/no offer she makes after the answer. If the visitor says yes, she does 'action'.
action types: {"type":"phase","phase":1-6} opens a phase of the site; {"type":"panel","panel":"Contact"} opens a site panel (Contact = Book a Demo form); {"type":"enter"} enters the site.
Do not put prices, dates, project names or promises here unless they are official and published on the website.
After editing, check the file is valid JSON (for example at jsonlint.com) and copy it to the other copies of the site (see docs/hannah-receptionist.md).
Onboarding, the guided tour and lead questions live in 'onboarding', 'tour' and 'lead'. After changing any line, run v2/nexora-src/hannah/video/make_clip_list.py and make the new videos.

voice._note: Hannah uses the visitor's browser voices. The first available voice in this list is used; otherwise the best English female voice the browser offers. Voices that report word timing (Microsoft natural voices in Edge, the Mac's own voices) give the most exact lip sync; Google's network voices in Chrome do not report it, so they come last.

company.name: Nexora
company.summary: Nexora is a real estate SaaS platform, powered by Jatta M Kommerce. It combines interactive 3D digital twins, site evaluation tools, construction tracking and buyer handover in one place, so developers can show, sell and manage villa and gated community projects before and while they are built.

greeting.first: Hello, and welcome to Nexora! I'm Hannah, your virtual receptionist. May I know your name?
greeting.returning: Welcome back! It's lovely to see you again. How can I help you today?
greeting.placeholder: Type your name, or ask me anything about Nexora...

topics.answer: Nexora is real estate software, powered by Jatta M Kommerce.

followUp.ask: Would you like to know what a 3D digital twin is?

more: It helps developers show their projects in 3D, before they're even built.
It also tracks construction and hands homes over to buyers, all in one place.

topics.answer: A digital twin is a photorealistic 3D copy of a project.

followUp.ask: Would you like to see the virtual tour of our example villa?

more: It's made from the architect's drawings, so buyers can explore every villa in the browser.
Nexora can turn Revit, ArchiCAD or BIM models into a twin in under 72 hours.

topics.answer: Nexora has five main modules, from the empty plot to residents moving in.

followUp.ask: Shall I walk you through them one at a time?

more: The first three are land and feasibility, a 3D sales gallery, and a construction tracker.
Then come quality and snagging, and finally a buyer handover and resident portal.

topics.answer: Nexora is built for real estate developers and builders.

followUp.ask: Are you a developer, or are you looking for a home yourself?

more: From boutique villa builders to large township developers.
Their buyers and residents use it too, to explore homes and follow construction.

topics.answer: Phase 1 is Site Evaluation, where a developer checks the plot before building.

followUp.ask: Would you like me to open Site Evaluation for you?

more: Nexora tracks road access, surveys, water, power, approvals, zoning and soil tests.

topics.answer: Phase 2 is Master Planning, where the villa layouts are finalised.

followUp.ask: Shall I open Master Planning so you can see it?

more: RERA registration is secured, and the 3D twin goes live for buyers, with live inventory and booking.

topics.answer: Phase 3 is Construction, where the towers and clubhouse rise from the ground.

followUp.ask: Would you like me to take you to the Construction phase?

more: Nexora tracks every milestone with drone images, bill checks and photo records.

topics.answer: Phase 4 is Fit-Out and Handover, when the interiors are finished.

followUp.ask: Shall I open Fit-Out and Handover for you?

more: Every home is checked against more than 200 quality points, and the keys are handed over after a walkthrough.

topics.answer: Phase 5 is Ready to Move In, when residents settle in.

followUp.ask: Would you like to see Ready to Move In?

more: The resident app handles amenity bookings, visitors, security and maintenance.

topics.answer: The Virtual Tour lets you explore our example luxury villa in 3D.

followUp.ask: Shall I start the virtual tour for you?

more: You can walk through the garden, the clubhouse and pool, the living pavilion and the master suite.

topics.answer: The website tells Nexora's story in five phases, plus a virtual tour.

followUp.ask: Would you like to start at the beginning, with Site Evaluation?

more: Site Evaluation, Master Planning, Construction, Fit-Out and Handover, and Ready to Move In.

topics.answer: Nexora has subscription plans for builders of every size.

tour._note: The guided tour. Hannah shrinks to a small video in the corner and the website moves to each phase while she explains it. Each step has its own video.

steps.say: Let's begin! This is Site Evaluation, where a developer checks the plot before building. Shall we move on?
This is Master Planning. The villa layouts are finalised, and the 3D twin goes live for buyers. Shall we move on?
Here is Construction. Nexora tracks every milestone with drone images and photo records. Shall we move on?
This is Fit-Out and Handover. Every home is quality checked before the keys are handed over. Shall we move on?
Welcome to Ready to Move In. The resident app handles bookings, visitors and maintenance. Shall we see the villa?
This is the virtual tour of our demo villa. Take your time, and look around.

tour.finish: {name}, that's the tour! Would you like a personal demo for your own project?
tour.stopped: No problem, we'll stop here. I'm always in the menu if you need me.
tour.howTo: Just scroll to move between the phases. The Menu at the top right lists them all.

lead._note: Lead details. Each answer is checked: phone must be a 10-digit Indian mobile or a number with country code; email must be a valid address. Where the lead is sent is decided later (super-admin portal).
lead.start: I'd be happy to arrange a free demo! What's the best phone number to reach you?
lead.startNoName: I'd be happy to arrange a free demo! May I have your name first?
lead.askPhone: Thank you! What's the best phone number to reach you?
lead.badPhone: Hmm, that number doesn't look right. Could you type it again, with ten digits?
lead.askEmail: Thank you. And your email address?
lead.badEmail: That email doesn't look quite right. Could you type it again?
lead.done: {name}, thank you! Our team will contact you soon. I'm opening the demo form, so you can pick a date.
lead.declined: No problem at all. The Book a Demo button is at the top, whenever you're ready.
